info.title: groundhog: give a local app a public HTTPS address through Groundhog.
info.description: The groundhog command: give a local dev server a public HTTPS address through Groundhog.

options.name: --port
options.description: The local port to forward to (http://localhost:<port>).

options.name: --target
options.description: An HTTP or HTTPS local target, for example https://localhost:7132.

options.name: --local-ca
options.description: --insecure-local Skip local certificate validation for loopback HTTPS only (unsafe).

options.name: --relay
options.description: Optional service address override for self-hosting or service migrations.

options.name: --key
options.description:
The tunnel's connection key. Prefer the GROUNDHOG_KEY environment variable,
which keeps the key out of your shell history and process list.

options.name: --pool
options.description: Connections to keep open to the relay, 1 to 8 (default 2).
